title: tpu-roofline Result
description: Output payload of the tpu-roofline agent. Every number it carries is modelled, not measured. The full report stays on disk; this payload carries the summary and the paths.

status.description: 'modeled': a roofline was computed. 'invalid_input': the request names nothing to model, or leaves out a required choice; every one is listed in `missing`. 'failed': the selftest or a script failed. The fields each status owes are declared in `status_requires` and enforced by the runtime.

summary.description: Short result: the headline numbers, what binds them, and what would have to change to move them.

provenance.description: Provenance label of every number in this result.

results.description: Optional headline numbers, keyed by metric name (for example roofline_ms, bound_by, t_prefill_ms, tpot_ms). Keys are not fixed.

rows.description: One floor per requested row and cell, when the request named `rows`.

layer_total_ms.description: The row's floor over every layer that runs it: per-layer floor x count, summed over layer kinds. Not roofline_data.json's per-layer floor_ms.

hardware.description: Where the hardware numbers came from. Per-field sources are in the config's `_provenance` and the report's Inputs table.

assumed.description: Modelling constants no spec page states (hop_latency, d2d_hop_latency, ici_contention, memory_utilization, resident_overhead_gb), each as `field=value` taken from the starting config. Specs are never assumed: a missing one is invalid_input.

unmodelled.description: Model components roofline.py has no op for, so the floor leaves them out and must not be read as complete. Absent when everything is modelled.

missing.description: Inputs the caller must add before a roofline can be computed, when status is 'invalid_input'.

artifacts.description: Paths of the files written: the report, the config, the raw output and the CSV, and for Path B and rows-only runs the roofline_data.json that roofline_data.py builds from the CSV.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

examples.summary: MoE down-projection, 8192 tokens: roofline 1.42 ms, HBM bound. Weight reads are 81% of the bytes.
Cannot compute the model roofline: the workload is not given.

missing.reason: ISL, OSL, max-num-batched-tokens and decode concurrency set every phase time.

examples.summary: MLA QK Rope at decode-b64-p50-90: 0.21 ms, MXU bound; 3 of its 4 GFLOP are contraction padding (D_rope 64 padded to 256).
